lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-density clusters of small, high-luminance circular pixel groups in the anterior post-branchial section, transitioning to a more sparse, grid-like arrangement of larger circular maxima towards the posterior mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased luminance intersecting with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid-like visual structure in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature on the upper flank, marked by a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the superior edge to a low-luminance shadow boundary on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several elongated, dark, low-luminance silhouettes attached to the lower lateral surface.
